note: The National Development Plan 2023-2027 commits, under priority 4.3.1, to build access points for civil registry and identity card services, modernise the technological infrastructure supporting them and strengthen their technical capacity, and sets birth registration completeness for under-fives at 38% (2022), 59% (2027) and 95% (2050); it names no registration system and says nothing of how an office registers, so there is no system to carry a fact.
